name: @agenticdevelopertoolkit/releases
description: Reads a macOS app's public releases repo (releases.json, release notes, Sparkle appcast.xml) and serves it from a site — a validated loader, a newest-first latest lookup, an appcast proxy handler, a latest-installer redirect handler, and what a downloads page shows a release's facts and words with (fill, releaseDate, releaseSize, releaseSystem, releaseNotesUrl). Knows no product: every call takes the repo's raw base URL.
